# Cudic

> Cudic is a browser studio for making games, sites, and themes, with saves, multiplayer, and a community built in. Nothing to install.

## About
Cudic combines a chat/community layer with a full browser-based game studio, a gallery of playable games, theme packs that restyle the whole site, and a small currency (coins) for rewarding creators. Everything runs in the browser.

## Key features
- Studio: VS Code-style workbench with file explorer, tabs, live preview, command palette. HTML/CSS/JS, import files/folders, Scratch import, Python (WebAssembly), npm via CDN.
- Gallery: publish games with permanent pages, card art, comments, likes, remix. Browse/search/sort.
- Chat & servers: public/private servers with channels, roles, DMs.
- Theme packs: full site restyles (colours, fonts, icons, motion, live scene). Try free, buy with coins.
- Cloud saves: progress follows the player's account. One script tag, 100 KB budget.
- Multiplayer: live rooms over Cudic's connection. Up to 32 players/room. Guests join without an account.
- Coins: earned via daily claims, quests, activity, ad bonuses, selling packs. Not real money.
- Cudic AI panel: chat with your model of choice about your project; apply code suggestions.
- Remix: fork any published game; credits carry up the chain.
